name: Back Extension
steps: Set the back extension bench so the pad sits just below your hip bones.
Hook your ankles under the foot pads and cross your arms over your chest.
With a straight back, bend at the hips and lower your upper body slowly.
Squeeze your glutes and raise your body until it is in line with your legs.
Pause, then lower again with control.
cues: Hinge at the hips, back stays straight
Stop when body is in a straight line
Breathe in down, out as you rise

common_mistakes.mistake: Arching back past straight at the top
common_mistakes.fix: Stop when the body forms a straight line

common_mistakes.mistake: Rounding the back on the way down
common_mistakes.fix: Lower only as far as you can keep a flat back
Rise in 2 seconds and pause at the top
